gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Autour One draws round, bold letters with a single flat line weight and a clear channel running into each curve. Noto Sans Nabataean, a plain sans, handles the quieter text with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-north: Every stroke here is the same weight, bent like tubing. Make Autour One small and that bold presence fades, while Noto Sans Old North Arabian, a plain sans, holds a dense, lofty lowercase band with outward-pointing terminals.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdi: Noto Sans Old Sogdian has a lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. Its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk, and Autour One, a bold display face with no hairline strokes at all, makes a vivid partner.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-turki: Noto Sans Old Turkic is chunky and open-mouthed, its curves staying clear. Autour One, with letterforms like bent tubing, brings the bold display punch, while Noto Sans Old Turkic is the sans-serif that holds the lines together.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Autour One looks like a single-weight outline, bold and round. Noto Sans Oriya, a plain sans, adds generous gaps in its curves and small letters that rise almost to the capitals, which is its strongest quality.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Autour One has zero stroke contrast, so every round letter looks drawn with one bold line. And Noto Sans PhagsPa, a sans-serif, brings see-through openings and a gentle step up from small letters to capitals.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Bold, round and simple, like one pen tip drew it all. Noto Sans Sinhala, a sans-serif, lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, so a slightly larger size gives its curve endings more room.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar leaves daylight in its curves, like a rope's open bight. Beside Autour One, whose up and side strokes look identical, it keeps a longer passage flowing smoothly, with short ascender stems on its sturdy lowercase.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-syloti-na: Autour One's lowercase n has an arch and stem that match perfectly, giving it bold, expressive character. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri, a sans, keeps a longer passage easy to follow with short ascenders and an a whose lower bowl breathes.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke body, with small letters thick like bundled cable. Autour One does the loud display work with each stroke holding one thickness; Noto Sans Syriac Western, a sans-serif, does the modern, clean reading.
